family_reports.body: Broke us broke our hearts broke our spirits we don't know what to do or how to act without our son please somebody anybody out there help us give us words to keep moving forward to get our son back
Has caused me and my daughter ongoing trauma for the last six years. I’ve had to watch my daughter, lose the light from her eyes because of these people while I try desperately to save what’s left.
Took my grandkids from their family and placed them into a foster home traumatizing them and my daughter

they locked my fiancé up on false accusations then used TDC to get my mom to sign a paper giving them access to her phone cps gave me our kids back for a day and a half then showed up and snatched them all over agsin
It’s an ‘our way or no way’ system that tries to force compliance, tears families apart, and leaves lasting harm in its wake.
